title: Where? - Coordinates & Pings
description: Share, convert, display, and manage coordinates with pings, team pings, private coordinates, and chat menus.
body:
# What is _Where?_

**_Where?_** is a Minecraft utility mod for quickly sharing, displaying, converting, and managing coordinates.

The mod can detect coordinates in chat and lets you copy them, convert them between dimensions, display them as pings, or send them to other players.

## Features

- Detect coordinates in chat
- Copy coordinates quickly
- Convert coordinates between Overworld, Nether, and End
- Create normal world pings
- Create team-only pings
- Send private coordinates to specific players
- Send coordinates only to your team
- Use clickable coordinate menus in chat
- Manage teams with invites, leaders, members, and blocked players
- Customize ping color, size, range, transparency, lifetime, and display options

## Commands

![quick command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba4885a941d6894c13232b9b815fc38daa74887a.png)

Send your current coordinates:

`!coords`

Enter coordinates manually:

`!100 10 -30`

Send your coordinates privately to a player:

`!coords <player>`

Send your coordinates only to your team:

`!coords teams`

settings menu:

![coordinates settings menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58a889935b1c0794fac9caa918665b46c2302e6e.png)

## Team System

_Where?_ includes a team system with team invites, leaders, members, blocked players, private team coordinates, and team-only pings.

Team commands are available under:

`/where teams`

settings menu:

![team settings menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6be12e9445a58c52fe81555d5c79fd776a7708e6.png)

## Pings

Pings can show coordinates, distance, dimension, player face, creator information, arrows, and despawn timers.

You can configure how pings look and behave in the _Where?_ settings menu.

settings menu:

![ping settings menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67dfb9a080eb3a5e4df670c9c0c219e605bc8490.png)
